summary: Climber fell several hundred feet near the summit of Mt. Lindsey after a boulder gave way on the northwest ridge approach; extracted by REACH 71 helicopter and transferred by ambulance to the hospital in Alamosa.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; Costilla County Sheriff's Office; REACH 71
notes: AVSAR paged on the morning of June 5; REACH 71 met an AVSAR team member at the Mt. Blanca helipad at noon, made contact with the climber ~1:20 p.m. and returned to the helipad ~1:40 p.m.; mission concluded at 3 p.m.; climber's medical status not released at publication.
